description: Come along to share the adventure and fun of Hawaii's fishing lifestyle each week, led by host, Cindy Paliracio; Dave Lancaster learns about useful equipment and techniques in Tackle Tips and helps create great seafood dishes in Reel Recipes.

title: Ultimate Japan
description: The group is in Sado picking sweet apples. Sado is famous for seafood so they eat a delicious sushi lunch. They'll craft traditional paper cutouts before ending the day with a delightful dinner.

title: Lanai's Travel Club
description: Lanai Tabura is your travel guide to global destinations featuring good food, unique shopping, entertainment and more.

title: Fashion Sense By Valerie
description: Enjoy a stuffed avocado salad and cucumber mocktail. Deidre shares makeup tips for lash extensions, Dr. Hanna explains dizziness when standing up and Denise highlights the importance of home inspections. Plus, get easy shoe-pairing style tips.

title: Showcase Hawaii
description: The Mana Koa Wood Scroll Cuff blends strength, island style, and genuine koa wood inlay with a detailed Hawaiian scroll motif. Available in gold- or silver-plated brass, its 3/8 width offers bold design with everyday comfort for all.

title: The Champ Show
description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, tastes the cuisine of Hawaiis eateries and keeps you healthy and active with fitness and golf tips.
